peng_ai.name: Peng Ai
peng_ai.title: Keeper of apprenticeship credit and failed firings

peng_ai.appearance: Dark low hair knot; square brown linen coat and apron; ink fingers; repaired blue sleeve cuff; slate and ledger; calm direct gaze.

luo_sheng.appearance: Broad face; grey hair under wool cap; dark coat with scorched cuff; ordinary firing paddle.

tan_ning.appearance: Neat black hair; careful collar; muted blue robe with hidden elbow patch; folded orders.

zhu_yan.appearance: Cropped practical hair; clay ochre apron; ordinary right-hand support brace; amused lively eyes; wooden tray.

jian_rong.appearance: Lean; short untidy black hair; soot on nose; patched grey tunic; hemp work tablet; stubborn wary gaze.
